checks.name: CK_INS_CLAIM_LINE_INS_CLAIM_LI
checks.expression:
("qty_claim" <> CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(1)))
    AND ("amt_claimed" > CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(1)))

tables.comment: 医保理赔；一行代表一条医保理赔记录

checks.name: CK_INS_CLAIM_INS_CLAIM_AMOUNTS
checks.expression:
("amt_gross" > CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(1)))
    AND ("amt_ins_fund" >= CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(1)))
    AND ("amt_pers_acct" >= CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(1)))
    AND ("amt_pat_cash" >= CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(1)))
    AND ("amt_other_fund" >= CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(1)))

checks.name: CK_INS_CLAIM_INS_CLAIM_REVERSA
checks.expression:
(("sd_status" NOT IN('REVERSAL_PENDING', 'REVERSED'))
    AND ("dt_rvrsd" IS NULL))
    OR (("sd_status" = 'REVERSED')
    AND ("des_rvrsl_reason" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("dt_rvrsd" IS NOT NULL))
    OR (("sd_status" = 'REVERSAL_PENDING')
    AND ("des_rvrsl_reason" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("dt_rvrsd" IS NULL))
